author: Copilot
body: Now that this stack sets the WebBFF database name to `portal_bff`, there are still several in-repo comments/docstrings that claim the WebBFF DB name is `portal_webbff` (e.g. `backend/libs/cdk-extensions/cdk_extensions/infra/portal.py` and `backend/stacks/portal-db-forge/src/portal_db_forge_stack/run_migrate_webbff.py`). Please update those references (or centralize the DB name as a shared constant) so future deploy/debug work isn’t misled by outdated docs.
